messages:
acme-prod (Acct): Hey, production experiencing huge tail latency and 5xx/429s when traffic spikes. Requests queue for ~25-40s then 429. Happened during a scheduled campaign at 09:20 UTC. We use Dedicated with min_replicas=2, max=20.
jamie (Support): Sorry to hear that — can you share a sample request ID or curl? Any error body? Also which model + region?
acme-prod (Acct): sample request id: req_01G7Z9YX9X. Model: rw-instruct-large, region: eu-west-1. Error body: "backend: attach timeout" then 429. No auth errors in payload.
jamie (Support): Got it. Reproduced logs show scale-up didn't add pods fast enough. Lee, can you check autoscaler events + attach probe health?
lee (Eng-Oncall): Looking at k8s events: HPA triggered, but attach controller returned "probe failed" repeatedly. Warm-pool count was 0 for that pool. AutoscalerIss: scale request queued due to attach heartbeat timeout. deploy-bot triggered a scale but pods stuck in ContainerCreating for ~38s.
ana (Eng-Infra): ContainerCreating delay shows image pull backoff in node logs: registry rate-limited for that private registry account. Also saw IAM token refresh for node-service-account fail intermittently — 401s to metadata server for one node for ~20s.
matt (Customer Success): Customer reports they did not get any quota warnings beforehand. This is a campaign so even a small registry hiccup escalated quickly.
lee (Eng-Oncall): Root cause looks like two simultaneous issues: (1) warm-pool depleted, so we were relying on cold attach path; (2) registry pull + node IAM hiccup extended pod ready time, causing attach probe to fail and autoscaler not to consider pods healthy -> scale didn't serve requests fast enough.
jamie (Support): Immediate mitigations: 1) increase warm_pool size for that customer temporarily; 2) add a canary pre-pull policy for critical peaks; 3) we can temporarily bump min_replicas to 5 for the account to avoid cold starts. Customer OK with quick change?
acme-prod (Acct): Agree to bump min_replicas to 5 for next 48h. Please also share repro steps so we can add circuit in our side.
lee (Eng-Oncall): Repro steps we used:
```
# simulate spike
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' -d '{"model":"rw-instruct-large","prompt":"ping"}' -o /dev/null &
# watch attach controller events
kubectl -n dedicated-<acct> get events --watch
```
Also check cluster node logs for kubelet image pull and metadata server 401s.
ana (Eng-Infra): Long-term fixes: fallback path for attach to serve from other warm pools in same region, exponential backoff for registry pulls with JIT cache, and improve autoscaler to account for probe-in-progress time (treat as pending capacity). I'll add tickets.
deploy-bot: scale_event: requested=+6, applied=+6, time=2234567950
matt (Customer Success): I'll confirm with customer when min_replicas bump is live and monitor for 6 hours. Thanks.
jamie (Support): Closing loop: action items -> bump min_replicas, increase warm pool, infra tickets for registry/backoff + probe heuristics. tagging @ana @lee for follow-ups :thumbsup:
